sentences.englishText: Elvis Presley was born in 1935 in Mississippi and grew up in a poor but loving family.
sentences.turkishText: Elvis Presley 1935'te Mississippi'de doğdu ve fakir ama sevgi dolu bir ailede büyüdü.

sentences.englishText: He worked different jobs before his singing talent was discovered by Sam Phillips.
sentences.turkishText: Şarkı söyleme yeteneği Sam Phillips tarafından keşfedilmeden önce farklı işlerde çalıştı.

sentences.englishText: He became a rock and roll star with the help of his manager Tom Parker and won many awards.
sentences.turkishText: Menajeri Tom Parker'ın yardımıyla bir rock and roll yıldızı oldu ve birçok ödül kazandı.

enrichment.summary: Elvis Presley was born in 1935 in Mississippi and grew up in a poor but loving family. He worked different jobs before his singing talent was discovered by Sam Phillips.
